Name: (FF) MQ's Umbrellas
Author: Misquota
Description:
Adds 7 different umbrella swatches to choose from using[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Leroymilo/about-me?gameId=1303] Leroymilo's[/url] Furniture Framework.

[size=4]Installation & Usage
[/size]
1) Install prerequisite mods: SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]
[/url]2) Download this mod, unzip and place into Stardew Valley mods folder
3) Umbrellas can be found in the Furniture Catalogue

This is my first mod, I hope you like it! If there are any bugs or swatches that you would like me to add just let me know and I'll work on it!

Also if there are any mods that you would like me to make I am very open to suggestions.
